authority: Seoul Metropolitan Government — Hangang Bus (Han River Bus)
operator_note: Seoul Metropolitan Government public water-transit service; operated via Seoul city with I'SEOUL / Hangang Bus branding. Public transport authority stakeholder = Seoul Metropolitan Government (separate stakeholder from kakao-mobility commercial path).
city_node_status: existing_seed (dual-platform; _seed_node true; shared with kakao-mobility seoul-han-river market)
decarbonization_anchor: Hangang Bus launched official operations 18 Sep 2025 as a new public transport mode on the Han River; hybrid vessels with a stated pathway toward electrification, positioned by Seoul as a low-carbon commuting alternative to congested road corridors across a 10M-person city.
network_reality: Single trunk line, ~28.9 km, 7 piers: Magok, Mangwon, Yeouido, Oksu, Apgujeong, Ttukseom, Jamsil. Operates Eastern (Jamsil <-> Yeouido) and Western (Magok <-> Yeouido) route patterns. Widely reported as slow relative to demand — the credible authority gap a fast, silent foiling tier addresses.

reconciliation_rule: Han River piers are physically singular. Where Hangang and kakao-mobility name the same pier (Yeouido, Ttukseom, Jamsil), Grok must bind BOTH proposals to ONE canonical pier node (do not double-plot). Keep the two proposals as separate markets/stakeholders (SMG public transit vs kakao commercial); only the physical BP nodes are shared. Mint Hangang-exclusive piers (Magok, Mangwon, Oksu, Apgujeong) new.
